description: Institute of Chartered Accountants - The amendments to (SLFRSs 2 share based payments, SLFRS 15 - Revenue from contacts with Customers and SLFRS 4 Insurance Contracts) w.e.f. 01.01.2018
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the adoption and publication of amendments to Sri Lanka Accounting Standards (SLFRS) by the Institute of Chartered Accountants under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act. This constitutes regulatory framework updates and compliance requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government structure/personnel changes.
